text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That happened on Christmas Day—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What?!
Santa didn't come to your place?!
choice_data_list: They don't come anymore because they grew up.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's not true! Grandma always said,
'If you're a good girl and work hard,
Santa will always come!'

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fine, I'll make you understand that Santa comes for you too!
First things first—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna write a letter to Santa!
I'll show him what a good girl I've been!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Like today, for instance! You were, well, more or less
working hard at your job, weren't you?
That's the kind of thing you write in a letter!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maybe this is Sweep Tosho's way of
hype up Christmas.
To honor her feelings, I decided to play along.
choice_data_list: Got it, I'll give it a try and write it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No! Zero points! Write it properly!
Like how you keep a daily journal,
or wake up earlier than me to prep every morning!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Come on, do it over!
I won't let you get away with slacking off!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Sweep Tosho noticed things that even I had missed.
...I'll happily rewrite it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Well, it's a passing grade.
We're out of time, so this will have to do!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "All we have to do now is drop it in the mailbox and wait, but... I know a better way. Follow me!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Alright, which fir tree around here
is the tallest?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll go attach the letter to the very top
so Santa can spot it while flying through the sky!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to put them in danger.
I try to persuade them by suggesting they might not even get noticed while everyone is busy handing out presents.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... That's true, too.
But how do we get a letter to Santa...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Right! As my familiar
who's always flying all over the place, you—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I bet I could even fly through the sky!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So, I'll just meet Santa in person!
Then it'll also prove that I worked hard enough to go see him. Pretty good idea, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Come on, familiar! Jump!
I'll make you float with my magic!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As we kept jumping just as she instructed, the sun began to set...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I couldn't fly, and Santa never showed up either...
With no other choice, I decided to head back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Geez!! Why!? Why isn't Santa coming!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Grandma told me...!
Santa comes to kids who do their best!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: He comes to visit me every year too... saying 'You did great this year' and giving me magical tools and spellbooks!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And yet... not coming to your familiar's side
makes no sense at all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Santa, you idiot--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Learning the reason why she was so desperate, a warm feeling welled up inside me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, I'm definitely calling Santa next year!
And I'll lodge today's complaint right along with it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"For that reason, you'd better do your best for another year!
Understood?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With Sweep Tosho by my side,
maybe we really could meet Santa one day.
I truly believed that from the bottom of my heart."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...What are you laughing at, Familiar?!
Aren't you mad at Santa too?!
choice_data_list: Because I realized Sweep acknowledges me

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If today is the day one's year of hard work is recognized,
then I feel that more than enough.
It brings me far greater joy than any present from Santa.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What's that supposed to mean?! Just because I acknowledged it
doesn't mean I agree with everything! Geez!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: “Still, it's Christmas, so I'll throw in a bonus. Just for today, you did well, familiar!”

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I suppose it can't be helped! I'll give you a Christmas present magic spell! Just for you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Pair Tree Healing!
Find rest through holy blessing! Hyah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho snatched my smartphone
and turned off the power!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪ Now we can enjoy Christmas
without anyone or any schedule getting in our way!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Next... I know!
We're going to walk together through this city
enchanted by the magic of lights!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "And then we're going to eat shortcake! I'll take all the strawberries for you. Their magical power is a bit too strong for you, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The dazzling city illuminations seemed to shine brighter than in years past... It was truly a wonderful Christmas spent together.
